title: Fixes LP: #2116290 with a patch df-statfs-fallback.
description:
Fixes LP: #2116290 with a patch df-statfs-fallback.
 
Some chroots, specifically ones used in Launchpad, have absolute
paths in their /proc/self/mountinfo files. The default from_path()
method matches chroot-relative paths against absolute paths, which
always fails, causing LP: #2116290. GNU uses a stat approach by 
default so it doesn't have this problem. The patch adds a fallback to
the statfs-based from_path_direct() method when the  mount is missing. 

- coreutils-from
	- d/uutils: reinstates rust-coreutils df 
- rust-coreutils:
	- d/patches: new patch that adds a statfs fallback

PPA: ppa:varranvar/fix2116290

The main testing is that df no longer throws errors on Launchpad 
builds. Further testing is based on a best approximation of the bug,
since I don't have access to the Launchpad build environment.

test.sh ( a script for reproducing the bug):
```bash
#!/bin/bash
set -e

unshare -m bash << 'INNER'
UU_DF=/usr/lib/cargo/bin/coreutils/df
GNU_DF=/usr/bin/df

CR=$(mktemp -d)

cleanup() {
    umount "$CR/proc"
    rm -rf "$CR"
}
trap cleanup EXIT


mkdir -p "$CR"/{proc,usr/lib/cargo/bin/coreutils,usr/bin}

# Copy binaries and their shared libraries into the chroot.
for bin in "$UU_DF" "$GNU_DF"; do
    cp "$bin" "$CR$(dirname $bin)/"
    ldd "$bin" 2>/dev/null \
        | grep -o '/[^ ]*\.so[^ ]*' \
        | while read lib; do
            [ -f "$lib" ] && cp --parents "$lib" "$CR/" 2>/dev/null || true
        done
done
cp --parents /lib64/ld-linux-x86-64.so.2 "$CR/" 2>/dev/null || true

# Bind-mount the host's /proc into the chroot. The chroot now sees
# host-absolute mount_dirs in mountinfo, which causes the bug.
mount --bind /proc "$CR/proc"

echo "--- uutils df ---"
chroot "$CR" /usr/lib/cargo/bin/coreutils/df --version
chroot "$CR" /usr/lib/cargo/bin/coreutils/df 

echo ""
echo "--- GNU df ---"
chroot "$CR" /usr/bin/df --version 
chroot "$CR" /usr/bin/df 

INNER
```

Steps to test:
```bash
lxc launch ubuntu-daily:resolute tester
lxc file push test.sh tester/
lxc exec tester -- bash
apt update
sudo bash /test.sh
```
GNU df should succeed and rust-coreutils df should output: 
"no file systems processed".

```bash
add-apt-repository ppa:varranvar/fix2116290
apt update
apt install rust-coreutils
sudo bash /test.sh
```
GNU df and the patched rust-coreutils df should both succeed.
